name: customsearch
description: Searches over a website or collection of websites

googlehost.description: **Deprecated**. Use the `gl` parameter for a similar effect. The local Google domain (for example, google.com, google.de, or google.fr) to use to perform the search.

snippetLength.description: Optional. Maximum length of snippet text, in characters, to be returned with results. Note: this feature is limited to specific engines. * Valid values are integers between 161 and 1000, inclusive.

imgType.description: Returns images of a type. Acceptable values are: * `"clipart"` * `"face"` * `"lineart"` * `"stock"` * `"photo"` * `"animated"`

siteSearch.description: Specifies a given site which should always be included or excluded from results (see `siteSearchFilter` parameter, below).

start.description: The index of the first result to return. The default number of results per page is 10, so `&start=11` would start at the top of the second page of results. **Note**: The JSON API will never return more than 100 results, even if more than 100 documents match the query, so setting the sum of `start + num` to a number greater than 100 will produce an error. Also note that the maximum value for `num` is 10.

imgSize.description: Returns images of a specified size. Acceptable values are: * `"huge"` * `"icon"` * `"large"` * `"medium"` * `"small"` * `"xlarge"` * `"xxlarge"`

fileType.description: Restricts results to files of a specified extension. A list of file types indexable by Google can be found in Search Console [Help Center](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/35287).

imgColorType.description: Returns black and white, grayscale, transparent, or color images. Acceptable values are: * `"color"` * `"gray"` * `"mono"`: black and white * `"trans"`: transparent background

orTerms.description: Provides additional search terms to check for in a document, where each document in the search results must contain at least one of the additional search terms.

searchType.description: Specifies the search type: `image`. If unspecified, results are limited to webpages. Acceptable values are: * `"image"`: custom image search.
enumDescriptions: Search type unspecified (defaults to web search).

sort.description: The sort expression to apply to the results. The sort parameter specifies that the results be sorted according to the specified expression i.e. sort by date. [Example: sort=date](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/structured_search#sort-by-attribute).

dateRestrict.description: Restricts results to URLs based on date. Supported values include: * `d[number]`: requests results from the specified number of past days. * `w[number]`: requests results from the specified number of past weeks. * `m[number]`: requests results from the specified number of past months. * `y[number]`: requests results from the specified number of past years.

imgDominantColor.description: Returns images of a specific dominant color. Acceptable values are: * `"black"` * `"blue"` * `"brown"` * `"gray"` * `"green"` * `"orange"` * `"pink"` * `"purple"` * `"red"` * `"teal"` * `"white"` * `"yellow"`

siteSearchFilter.description: Controls whether to include or exclude results from the site named in the `siteSearch` parameter. Acceptable values are: * `"e"`: exclude * `"i"`: include
enumDescriptions: Exclude results from the listed sites.
Include only results from the listed sites.
SafeSearch mode unspecified. (Falls back to engine's configuration.)
safe.description: Search safety level. Acceptable values are: * `"active"`: Enables SafeSearch filtering. * `"off"`: Disables SafeSearch filtering. (default)

highRange.description: Specifies the ending value for a search range. * Use `lowRange` and `highRange` to append an inclusive search range of `lowRange...highRange` to the query.

cx.description: The Programmable Search Engine ID to use for this request.

lr.description: Restricts the search to documents written in a particular language (e.g., `lr=lang_ja`). gl.description: Geolocation of end user. * The `gl` parameter value is a two-letter country code. The `gl` parameter boosts search results whose country of origin matches the parameter value. hq.description: Appends the specified query terms to the query, as if they were combined with a logical AND operator.

filter.description: Controls turning on or off the duplicate content filter. * See [Automatic Filtering](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#automaticFiltering) for more information about Google's search results filters. Note that host crowding filtering applies only to multi-site searches. * By default, Google applies filtering to all search results to improve the quality of those results. Acceptable values are: * `0`: Turns off duplicate content filter. * `1`: Turns on duplicate content filter.

hl.description: Sets the user interface language. * Explicitly setting this parameter improves the performance and the quality of your search results. * See the [Interface Languages](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#wsInterfaceLanguages) section of [Internationalizing Queries and Results Presentation](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#wsInternationalizing) for more information, and [Supported Interface Languages](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#interfaceLanguages) for a list of supported languages.

num.description: Number of search results to return. * Valid values are integers between 1 and 10, inclusive.

exactTerms.description: Identifies a phrase that all documents in the search results must contain.

cr.description: Restricts search results to documents originating in a particular country. You may use [Boolean operators](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#booleanOperators) in the cr parameter's value. Google Search determines the country of a document by analyzing: * the top-level domain (TLD) of the document's URL * the geographic location of the Web server's IP address See the [Country Parameter Values](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#countryCollections) page for a list of valid values for this parameter.

c2coff.description: Enables or disables [Simplified and Traditional Chinese Search](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#chineseSearch). The default value for this parameter is 0 (zero), meaning that the feature is enabled. Supported values are: * `1`: Disabled * `0`: Enabled (default)

rights.description: Filters based on licensing. Supported values include: `cc_publicdomain`, `cc_attribute`, `cc_sharealike`, `cc_noncommercial`, `cc_nonderived` and combinations of these. See [typical combinations](https://wiki.creativecommons.org/wiki/CC_Search_integration).

enableAlternateSearchHandler.description: Optional. Enables routing of Programmable Search Engine requests to an alternate search handler.

title: Custom Search API

Search.description: Response to a custom search request.

kind.description: Unique identifier for the type of current object. For this API, it is customsearch#search.

items.description: The current set of custom search results.

spelling.description: Spell correction information for a query.

htmlCorrectedQuery.description: The corrected query, formatted in HTML.

queries.description: Query metadata for the previous, current, and next pages of results.

rights.description: Filters based on licensing. Supported values include: * `cc_publicdomain` * `cc_attribute` * `cc_sharealike` * `cc_noncommercial` * `cc_nonderived`

filter.description: Activates or deactivates the automatic filtering of Google search results. See [Automatic Filtering](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#automaticFiltering) for more information about Google's search results filters. Valid values for this parameter are: * `0`: Disabled * `1`: Enabled (default) **Note**: By default, Google applies filtering to all search results to improve the quality of those results.

count.description: Number of search results returned in this set.

startPage.description: The page number of this set of results, where the page length is set by the `count` property.

googleHost.description: Specifies the Google domain (for example, google.com, google.de, or google.fr) to which the search should be limited.

highRange.description: Specifies the ending value for a search range. Use `cse:lowRange` and `cse:highrange` to append an inclusive search range of `lowRange...highRange` to the query.

inputEncoding.description: The character encoding supported for search requests.

imgColorType.description: Restricts results to images of a specified color type. Supported values are: * `mono` (black and white) * `gray` (grayscale) * `color` (color)

sort.description: Specifies that results should be sorted according to the specified expression. For example, sort by date.

siteSearchFilter.description: Specifies whether to include or exclude results from the site named in the `sitesearch` parameter. Supported values are: * `i`: include content from site * `e`: exclude content from site

exactTerms.description: Identifies a phrase that all documents in the search results must contain.

fileType.description: Restricts results to files of a specified extension. Filetypes supported by Google include: * Adobe Portable Document Format (`pdf`) * Adobe PostScript (`ps`) * Lotus 1-2-3 (`wk1`, `wk2`, `wk3`, `wk4`, `wk5`, `wki`, `wks`, `wku`) * Lotus WordPro (`lwp`) * Macwrite (`mw`) * Microsoft Excel (`xls`) * Microsoft PowerPoint (`ppt`) * Microsoft Word (`doc`) * Microsoft Works (`wks`, `wps`, `wdb`) * Microsoft Write (`wri`) * Rich Text Format (`rtf`) * Shockwave Flash (`swf`) * Text (`ans`, `txt`). Additional filetypes may be added in the future. An up-to-date list can always be found in Google's [file type FAQ](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/35287).

imgDominantColor.description: Restricts results to images with a specific dominant color. Supported values are: * `red` * `orange` * `yellow` * `green` * `teal` * `blue` * `purple` * `pink` * `white` * `gray` * `black` * `brown`

imgSize.description: Restricts results to images of a specified size. Supported values are: * `icon` (small) * `small | medium | large | xlarge` (medium) * `xxlarge` (large) * `huge` (extra-large)

siteSearch.description: Restricts results to URLs from a specified site.

linkSite.description: Specifies that all results should contain a link to a specific URL.

disableCnTwTranslation.description: Enables or disables the [Simplified and Traditional Chinese Search](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#chineseSearch) feature. Supported values are: * `0`: enabled (default) * `1`: disabled

orTerms.description: Provides additional search terms to check for in a document, where each document in the search results must contain at least one of the additional search terms. totalResults.description: Estimated number of total search results. May not be accurate.

dateRestrict.description: Restricts results to URLs based on date. cx.description: The identifier of an engine created using the Programmable Search Engine [Control Panel](https://programmablesearchengine.google.com/). This is a custom property not defined in the OpenSearch spec. This parameter is **required**.

outputEncoding.description: The character encoding supported for search results.

relatedSite.description: Specifies that all search results should be pages that are related to the specified URL. The parameter value should be a URL.

language.description: The language of the search results.

hl.description: Specifies the interface language (host language) of your user interface. Explicitly setting this parameter improves the performance and the quality of your search results. See the [Interface Languages](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#wsInterfaceLanguages) section of [Internationalizing Queries and Results Presentation](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#wsInternationalizing) for more information, and [Supported Interface Languages](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#interfaceLanguages) for a list of supported languages.

imgDominantColor.description: Restricts results to images with a specific dominant color. Supported values are: * `red` * `orange` * `yellow` * `green` * `teal` * `blue` * `purple` * `pink` * `white` * `gray` * `black` * `brown`

searchType.description: Allowed values are `web` or `image`. If unspecified, results are limited to webpages.

totalResults.description: Estimated number of total search results. May not be accurate.

siteSearchFilter.description: Specifies whether to include or exclude results from the site named in the `sitesearch` parameter. Supported values are: * `i`: include content from site * `e`: exclude content from site

dateRestrict.description: Restricts results to URLs based on date. Supported values include: * `d[number]`: requests results from the specified number of past days. * `w[number]`: requests results from the specified number of past weeks. * `m[number]`: requests results from the specified number of past months. * `y[number]`: requests results from the specified number of past years.

cr.description: Restricts search results to documents originating in a particular country. You may use [Boolean operators](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#BooleanOrSearch) in the `cr` parameter's value. Google WebSearch determines the country of a document by analyzing the following: * The top-level domain (TLD) of the document's URL. * The geographic location of the web server's IP address. See [Country (cr) Parameter Values](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#countryCollections) for a list of valid values for this parameter.

safe.description: Specifies the [SafeSearch level](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#safeSearchLevels) used for filtering out adult results. This is a custom property not defined in the OpenSearch spec. Valid parameter values are: * `"off"`: Disable SafeSearch * `"active"`: Enable SafeSearch

previousPage.description: Metadata representing the previous page of results, if applicable.

excludeTerms.description: Identifies a word or phrase that should not appear in any documents in the search results.

cx.description: The identifier of an engine created using the Programmable Search Engine [Control Panel](https://programmablesearchengine.google.com/). This is a custom property not defined in the OpenSearch spec. This parameter is **required**.

searchType.description: Allowed values are `web` or `image`. If unspecified, results are limited to webpages.

sort.description: Specifies that results should be sorted according to the specified expression. For example, sort by date.

siteSearch.description: Restricts results to URLs from a specified site.

relatedSite.description: Specifies that all search results should be pages that are related to the specified URL. The parameter value should be a URL.

gl.description: Boosts search results whose country of origin matches the parameter value. See [Country Codes](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#countryCodes) for a list of valid values. Specifying a `gl` parameter value in WebSearch requests should improve the relevance of results. This is particularly true for international customers and, even more specifically, for customers in English-speaking countries other than the United States.

searchTerms.description: The search terms entered by the user.

cr.description: Restricts search results to documents originating in a particular country. You may use [Boolean operators](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#BooleanOrSearch) in the `cr` parameter's value. See [Country (cr) Parameter Values](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#countryCollections) for a list of valid values for this parameter.

totalResults.description: Estimated number of total search results. May not be accurate.

disableCnTwTranslation.description: Enables or disables the [Simplified and Traditional Chinese Search](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#chineseSearch) feature. Supported values are: * `0`: enabled (default) * `1`: disabled

fileType.description: Restricts results to files of a specified extension. Filetypes supported by Google include: * Adobe Portable Document Format (`pdf`) * Adobe PostScript (`ps`) * Lotus 1-2-3 (`wk1`, `wk2`, `wk3`, `wk4`, `wk5`, `wki`, `wks`, `wku`) * Lotus WordPro (`lwp`) * Macwrite (`mw`) * Microsoft Excel (`xls`) * Microsoft PowerPoint (`ppt`) * Microsoft Word (`doc`) * Microsoft Works (`wks`, `wps`, `wdb`) * Microsoft Write (`wri`) * Rich Text Format (`rtf`) * Shockwave Flash (`swf`) * Text (`ans`, `txt`). Additional filetypes may be added in the future. An up-to-date list can always be found in Google's [file type FAQ](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/35287).

safe.description: Specifies the [SafeSearch level](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#safeSearchLevels) used for filtering out adult results. This is a custom property not defined in the OpenSearch spec. Valid parameter values are: * `"off"`: Disable SafeSearch * `"active"`: Enable SafeSearch

linkSite.description: Specifies that all results should contain a link to a specific URL.

imgColorType.description: Restricts results to images of a specified color type. Supported values are: * `mono` (black and white) * `gray` (grayscale) * `color` (color)

googleHost.description: Specifies the Google domain (for example, google.com, google.de, or google.fr) to which the search should be limited.

startPage.description: The page number of this set of results, where the page length is set by the `count` property.

imgDominantColor.description: Restricts results to images with a specific dominant color. Supported values are: * `red` * `orange` * `yellow` * `green` * `teal` * `blue` * `purple` * `pink` * `white` * `gray` * `black` * `brown`

imgType.description: Restricts results to images of a specified type. Supported values are: * `clipart` (Clip art) * `face` (Face) * `lineart` (Line drawing) * `photo` (Photo) * `animated` (Animated) * `stock` (Stock)

exactTerms.description: Identifies a phrase that all documents in the search results must contain.

siteSearchFilter.description: Specifies whether to include or exclude results from the site named in the `sitesearch` parameter. Supported values are: * `i`: include content from site * `e`: exclude content from site

highRange.description: Specifies the ending value for a search range. Use `cse:lowRange` and `cse:highrange` to append an inclusive search range of `lowRange...highRange` to the query.

filter.description: Activates or deactivates the automatic filtering of Google search results. See [Automatic Filtering](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#automaticFiltering) for more information about Google's search results filters. Valid values for this parameter are: * `0`: Disabled * `1`: Enabled (default) **Note**: By default, Google applies filtering to all search results to improve the quality of those results.

outputEncoding.description: The character encoding supported for search results.

language.description: The language of the search results.

inputEncoding.description: The character encoding supported for search requests.

rights.description: Filters based on licensing. Supported values include: * `cc_publicdomain` * `cc_attribute` * `cc_sharealike` * `cc_noncommercial` * `cc_nonderived`

orTerms.description: Provides additional search terms to check for in a document, where each document in the search results must contain at least one of the additional search terms. You can also use the [Boolean OR](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#BooleanOrSearch) query term for this type of query.

imgSize.description: Restricts results to images of a specified size. Supported values are: * `icon` (small) * `small | medium | large | xlarge` (medium) * `xxlarge` (large) * `huge` (extra-large)

count.description: Number of search results returned in this set.

lowRange.description: Specifies the starting value for a search range. Use `cse:lowRange` and `cse:highrange` to append an inclusive search range of `lowRange...highRange` to the query.

context.description: Metadata and refinements associated with the given search engine, including: * The name of the search engine that was used for the query. * A set of [facet objects](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/refinements#create) (refinements) you can use for refining a search.

promotions.description: The set of [promotions](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/promotions). Present only if the custom search engine's configuration files define any promotions for the given query.

type.description: The MIME type of the OpenSearch URL template for the Custom Search JSON API.

searchTime.description: The time taken for the server to return search results.

formattedTotalResults.description: The total number of search results, formatted according to locale style.

formattedSearchTime.description: The time taken for the server to return search results, formatted according to locale style.

totalResults.description: The total number of search results returned by the query.

snippet.description: The snippet of the search result, in plain text.

htmlFormattedUrl.description: The HTML-formatted URL displayed after the snippet for each search result.

displayLink.description: An abridged version of this search result’s URL, e.g. www.example.com.

cacheId.description: Indicates the ID of Google's cached version of the search result.

htmlSnippet.description: The snippet of the search result, in HTML.

image.description: Image belonging to a custom search result.

byteSize.description: The size of the image, in bytes.

thumbnailLink.description: A URL to the thumbnail image.

thumbnailWidth.description: The width of the thumbnail image, in pixels.

thumbnailHeight.description: The height of the thumbnail image, in pixels.

contextLink.description: A URL pointing to the webpage hosting the image.

height.description: The height of the image, in pixels.

width.description: The width of the image, in pixels.

formattedUrl.description: The URL displayed after the snippet for each search result.

htmlTitle.description: The title of the search result, in HTML.

kind.description: A unique identifier for the type of current object. For this API, it is `customsearch#result.`

labels.description: Encapsulates all information about refinement labels.

label_with_op.description: Refinement label and the associated refinement operation.

name.description: The name of a refinement label, which you can use to refine searches. Don't display this in your user interface; instead, use displayName.

displayName.description: The display name of a refinement label. This is the name you should display in your user interface.

items.description: Refinement label associated with a custom search result.

mime.description: The MIME type of the search result.

fileFormat.description: The file format of the search result.

title.description: The title of the search result, in plain text.

link.description: The full URL to which the search result is pointing, e.g. http://www.example.com/foo/bar.

pagemap.description: Contains [PageMap](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/structured_data#pagemaps) information for this search result.

displayLink.description: An abridged version of this search's result URL, e.g. www.example.com.

url.description: The URL of the block object's link, if it has one.

link.description: The anchor text of the block object's link, if it has a link.

title.description: The block object's text, if it has text.

htmlTitle.description: The block object's text in HTML, if it has text.

items.description: Block object belonging to a promotion.

bodyLines.description: An array of block objects for this promotion.

source.description: URL of the image for this promotion link.

htmlTitle.description: The title of the promotion, in HTML.
